name: ngtchain
description: Each call spends real NGT or USDC from a wallet you fund, within user-defined per-call caps and session budgets. Handles HTTP 402 paywalled endpoints and streaming data natively on Base L2.
long_description: Each call spends real NGT or USDC from a wallet you fund, within the per-call cap and session budget you set. pay_and_fetch calls an API behind an NGT x402 paywall and pays only at or under your cap. fetch_ngt_stream is a real payment of 0.001 NGT, not a test. USDC on Base stays off unless you set its own cap and budget. The key signs on this computer. The seller pays the gas. Use a dedicated wallet that holds only what you plan to spend. The money protection is max_price and session_budget. destructiveHint is only a hint.

tools.name: pay_and_fetch
tools.description: Call an NGT-paywalled API. Pays real NGT or USDC at or under the cap.

tools.name: fetch_ngt_stream
tools.description: One NGT stream call. A real payment of 0.001 NGT, not a test.

tools.name: ngt_wallet_status
tools.description: Agent wallet address, balances, caps and budget left. Spends nothing.

tools.name: fund_agent_wallet
tools.description: Opens a browser page asking your own wallet to send NGT to the agent.

agent_private_key.title: Agent wallet private key
agent_private_key.description: Private key of a dedicated wallet holding NGT on Base. It stays in the extension settings on this computer and only signs payments within your caps.

max_price.title: Max price per call (NGT)
max_price.description: The most one call may pay in NGT. This cap is what stops a larger payment.

session_budget.title: Session budget (NGT)
session_budget.description: The most this server process may spend in NGT. This budget is what stops further payments.

host_headers.title: API key headers per host (optional)
host_headers.description: Only for paid APIs that also need a key. JSON, for example {"api.example.com":{"x-api-key":"..."}}. Each header is sent only to its host, never across a redirect, and the model never sees it. Leave empty otherwise.

usdc_max_price.title: Max price per call (USDC, optional)
usdc_max_price.description: The most one call may pay in USDC on Base. 0 keeps USDC off. USDC is paid only when this and the USDC session budget are both above 0.

usdc_session_budget.title: Session budget (USDC, optional)
usdc_session_budget.description: The most this server process may spend in USDC. Kept separate from the NGT budget. 0 keeps USDC off.

preferred_currency.title: Token to pay when a seller takes both
preferred_currency.description: NGT or USDC. Only matters when USDC is on.
